problem.title: Find the Cousins of a Given Node
problem.problemStatement: Given the root of a binary tree and a target node, determine all cousin nodes of the target. Two nodes are cousins if they are at the same depth but have different parents.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The next N lines describe the binary tree. • The last line contains the target node.
problem.output: • Print all cousin nodes in the required order. If none exist, print NONE.
